Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the podcast repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; tests are fixture-only with invented people (never real contacts).

OWNED FILES (only these, both new):
  scripts/funnel_ledger.py
  tests/test_funnel_ledger.py

CONTEXT (owner decision, Ankit 2026-08-03): HubSpot+Gmail+Calendar are the evidence layers (source of truth for people and touches). The repo needs ONE canonical machine state file, FUNNEL-LEDGER.json, rebuilt by reconciling against evidence every run, replacing today's fragmented hand-edited state (episodes/CANDIDATE-INBOX.json roster, episodes/SEND-HOLDS.json holds, episodes/FUNNEL-STATE.md hand-written ledger). Read all three existing files at HEAD to understand current shapes. Real defect this fixes: a contact's hold expired 2026-07-08 with nothing watching it, and an owner email sent 7/29 never entered state because the markdown was hand-edited and 18 days stale.

BUILD scripts/funnel_ledger.py — a deterministic module + CLI (argparse, subcommands rebuild | drift | render | focus-holds):
1. LEDGER SCHEMA (document as module docstring + LEDGER_SCHEMA dict): file episodes/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json = {"schema": "funnel-ledger/v1", "generated_at": iso8601, "people": [{"id": slug, "name": str, "kind": "interview"|"solo"|"referral_source"|"unknown", "stage": one of ["new_inbound","outreach_sent","in_conversation","prep_link_sent","prep_call_booked","prep_call_done","recording_booked","recorded","published","dormant","declined"], "last_touch": {"at": iso8601|null, "direction": "inbound"|"outbound"|null, "source": str evidence ref}, "hold": null | {"reason": str, "until": iso date, "next_action_on": iso date, "intent": str}, "next_action": str, "next_action_due": iso date|null, "evidence": [str refs], "provenance": str, "first_seen": iso8601, "updated_at": iso8601}]}
2. rebuild --state-dir <dir> --evidence <path.json> [--out <path>]: merges (a) existing ledger if present, (b) CANDIDATE-INBOX.json rows, (c) SEND-HOLDS.json holds (match by case-insensitive name or email), (d) an EVIDENCE FILE: {"touches": [{"person": name-or-email, "at": iso8601, "direction": "inbound"|"outbound", "source": str}]} — this file is produced at runtime by a thin Gmail/Calendar adapter that is NOT your job; your job is the pure merge. Newest touch wins for last_touch; a person present in evidence but absent from ledger+roster is ADDED with stage new_inbound and flagged in the receipt as unledgered_added. Never silently drop a person; people never delete, they become dormant or declined.
3. drift --state-dir --evidence: read-only compare of current ledger vs evidence + roster + holds; prints a drift report (each mismatch: person, field, ledger value, evidence value) and exits nonzero if drift_count > 0 OR unledgered_count > 0. This exit code IS the auditable goal (drift=0, unledgered=0).
4. focus-holds --state-dir --today <iso date>: lists holds where next_action_on <= today, as JSON focus items {person, intent, overdue_days}; exit 0 always (reporting, not gating).
5. render --state-dir: regenerates episodes/FUNNEL-STATE.md from the ledger with a first-line banner 'GENERATED from FUNNEL-LEDGER.json — do not hand-edit'. Preserve nothing from the old file; the ledger is the only input.
6. Every mutating subcommand writes a receipt JSON to episodes/receipts/funnel-ledger-<subcommand>-<UTC yyyymmddTHHMMSS>.json: {subcommand, counts: {people, unledgered_added, holds_active, holds_overdue, drift}, generated_at}. Atomic writes (tmp file + os.replace). Timezone-aware UTC datetimes only. No PII beyond names/emails already in state files; never log message bodies.

tests/test_funnel_ledger.py — at least 10 'def test_' functions using tmp_path fixtures with INVENTED people: rebuild from roster+holds produces valid schema; newest touch wins; inbound evidence for an unknown person adds them as new_inbound and counts unledgered_added; drift exits nonzero on a seeded mismatch and prints the person+field; drift exits 0 on a clean rebuild; hold matched by name lands on the right person; focus-holds lists an expired hold with overdue_days and omits future holds; render writes the do-not-hand-edit banner and one row per person; receipt file written with correct counts; people are never deleted on rebuild when absent from evidence (become/stay dormant only if stage rules say so — encode: absent from evidence changes nothing, dormancy is only set when a hold or explicit status says so).

VERIFY: 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_funnel_ledger.py -q -p no:cacheprovider' green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 10 new tests, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: one canonical machine ledger with reconcile-from-evidence, zero-drift and zero-unledgered gates, enforced hold expiry, and FUNNEL-STATE.md demoted to a generated view

tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the podcast repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; tests are fixture-only with invented people/episodes.

OWNED FILES (only these, all new):
  scripts/funnel_controller.py
  scripts/postpublish_qa.py
  tests/test_funnel_controller.py
  tests/test_postpublish_qa.py

CONTEXT (owner goal spec, Ankit 2026-08-03): publish takt is 1 episode/week (Thursday). Hopper target 6, minimum 2, at least 2 interviews in the mix, and at least 1 FINISHED interview ready-to-go at all times. Goals are a control loop, not fixed timers: when cover is short, clocks tighten and outreach opens; when the hopper is full, outreach closes to nurture-only. Read scripts/funnel_status.py and scripts/podcast_funnel_reconciler.py at HEAD to learn the existing cover dict shape (guest_cover_weeks, slot_cover_weeks, slots_at_risk, should_outreach) — CONSUME that shape, do not reimplement cover math.

BUILD scripts/funnel_controller.py — deterministic module + CLI (argparse):
1. INPUTS: --ledger <FUNNEL-LEDGER.json path> (schema funnel-ledger/v1: people[] with id,name,kind,stage,last_touch{at,direction,source},hold{reason,until,next_action_on,intent}|null,next_action,next_action_due,evidence,first_seen,updated_at; stages: new_inbound,outreach_sent,in_conversation,prep_link_sent,prep_call_booked,prep_call_done,recording_booked,recorded,published,dormant,declined), --cover <json file with the funnel_status cover/production shape> (accept a reduced fixture: {"guest_cover_weeks": int, "slot_cover_weeks": int, "finished_interviews_ready": int, "hopper_total": int, "production_stuck": [{"episode": str, "stage": str, "silent_skips": int}]}), --today <iso date>, --caps <json: {"outbound_per_day": 12, "new_contacts_per_day": 5, "per_contact_cadence_floor_days": 4}>.
2. MODE: CRITICAL if hopper_total < 2 or finished_interviews_ready < 1; DEFICIT if guest_cover_weeks < 10 or slot_cover_weeks < 4 (lead-time floor: ~8 week booking-to-publish + 2 safety); SURPLUS if hopper_total >= 6 and guest_cover_weeks >= 10; else NORMAL.
3. CLOCKS by mode (days): nudge dwell 14 SURPLUS / 7 NORMAL / 3 DEFICIT+CRITICAL; positive reply to prep_call_booked 7 NORMAL / 3 DEFICIT+CRITICAL; prep_call_done to recording_booked 14 NORMAL / 7 DEFICIT+CRITICAL. HOLD OVERRIDE IS ABSOLUTE: a person with hold.next_action_on in the future is untouchable regardless of mode; overdue holds surface as gentle context-aware items, never bulk nudges.
4. FOCUS LIST (the output that drives the loop): ordered items {priority int, kind: production_unstick|booking_overdue|nudge_due|hold_expired|new_outreach, person_or_episode, reason, due, mode}. Priority: (1) production_stuck items (nearest-done first: publish-queued before video-assembled before content-generated), (2) prep_call_done overdue for recording booking, (3) hold_expired items, (4) nudge_due per clocks + cadence floor, (5) new_outreach quota. Quota = 0 in SURPLUS; else ceil(max(0, required_active - projected_active) / reply_rate) where required_active derives from guest cover shortfall with a documented formula, reply_rate default 0.3 overridable via --assumptions json; clamp to caps.
5. OUTPUTS: focus list JSON to stdout AND episodes/receipts/funnel-controller-<UTC ts>.json receipt {mode, inputs_summary, clocks, focus_count_by_kind, generated_at}; also write episodes/objectives-observed.json: {"schema": "objectives-observed/v1", "observed": {"hopper_depth": int, "hopper_interviews_ready": int, "publish_reliability_note": str|null}, "mode": str, "generated_at": iso}. Atomic writes, timezone-aware UTC.
6. Deterministic throughout: same inputs, same output ordering (stable sort keys). No randomness, no network, no LLM.

BUILD scripts/postpublish_qa.py — fail-closed episode QA end-cap, CLI: --episode-dir <path> --today <iso>: checks (a) publish evidence present (episode.json or receipts contain a public URL for audio or video; document the exact keys you accept after reading one real episode.json in episodes/ for shape), (b) promo kit receipt exists, (c) referral ask receipt exists dated <= 72h after publish for interview episodes (skip rule for solo, documented), (d) a day7-metrics slot file exists or is explicitly pending with a due date. Output: QA receipt json to the episode dir (qa-postpublish-<ts>.json) with per-check pass/fail and overall PASS only when all required checks pass; exit nonzero on overall FAIL. Missing evidence is FAIL, never a warning (deny-by-default).

tests: tests/test_funnel_controller.py at least 9 tests: mode selection for all four modes including the CRITICAL floor (zero finished interviews forces CRITICAL even with big hopper_total); clock tightening in DEFICIT; hold in future suppresses nudge even in CRITICAL; expired hold surfaces as hold_expired not nudge_due; focus ordering puts production_unstick first and nearest-done first within it; outreach quota 0 in SURPLUS; quota clamped by caps; cadence floor suppresses a nudge younger than 4 days; receipt + objectives-observed written with correct counts. tests/test_postpublish_qa.py at least 3 tests: all-green PASS; missing referral ask within 72h FAILs an interview episode; solo episode skips the referral check per documented rule.

VERIFY: 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_funnel_controller.py tests/test_postpublish_qa.py -q -p no:cacheprovider' green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 12 new tests total, or the verify command failing.
